test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Plain
solution: The correct answer is **"Fancy."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Plain"** means simple and unadorned, while fancy means elaborate and decorative. (किसी भी तरह से सजाया नहीं गया; बिना कुछ भी जोड़े) • **Example**: *She wore a **plain**__ black dress.* • The antonym of** "Plain" **is **"Fancy."** • **"Fancy"** means decorative or complicated. (सजावटी या जटिल, विशिष्‍ट) __ • **Example**: *The decorations were a little too **fancy**__ for my tastes.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 2, **Crazy**, is not the opposite of plain. Crazy means insane or irrational. (सनकी, पागल, मूर्ख) • Option 3, **Mean**, is not the opposite of plain. Mean means unkind or stingy. (धन आदि स्वयं के लिए रखना न कि दूसरों को देना; कंजूस, स्‍वार्थी) • Option 4, **Stupid**, is not the opposite of plain. Stupid means unintelligent or foolish. (मूर्ख, नासमझ) 1a6:Tac7, The correct answer is **"Affluent."**
